gloss: to speak; to put in a good word

definitions.gloss: to speak; to talk; to utter words
definitions.explanation: To speak or talk. Often used in negative contexts to describe someone being silent, sulking, or refusing to communicate.

definitions.gloss: to put in a good word; to use one's influence; to act as intermediary
definitions.explanation: To use personal connections or influence to help someone, often by speaking to the right person on their behalf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}かない。
⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}かなかった。
examples.english: We had a fight and didn't speak for a week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}くようになった。
examples.english: The baby has finally started to talk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}いて⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My senior put in a good word for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}いて⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{消|け}して→取り消す：04224_torikesu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the department head put in a word and got my transfer cancelled.

examples.japanese: ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{口|くち}を{利|き}いて⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れた→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: An acquaintance pulled some strings for me, and I was finally able to get a reservation.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is very commonly used in the negative ({口|くち}を{利|き}かない — to not speak) to describe someone giving the silent treatment or a child not yet speaking. Sense 2 implies using personal connections or influence to help someone — a culturally significant concept in Japan.

NOTE: Do not confuse the kanji ⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ in this expression with ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to hear/ask). The ⟦{利|き}く→利く：11845_kiku⟧ here means "to be effective" or "to function."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to speak, to talk — general verb for speaking
- {取|と}り{次|つ}ぐ: to relay, to act as intermediary — more formal mediation
